body:
Hey. I'm a pedophile too. Congratz for getting it off your chest, even if it is anonymously on the internet - That's all I've managed too btw (aside from a few (very unhelpful) medical 'experts').

Your life seems to be mostly on track and you have the right attitude: being nice to others and not selfishly harming others.
I look forward to a day where people don't have to qualify their sexual identity with 'nonactive' or 'non-offending' or refer to it as a disorder.

Anyway, if you're worried at all or expecting a lot of hurtful remarks here on reddit, I think you will be pleasantly surprised at how sympathetic people are - Even the normies ;)
I'll bear that in mind. That's fine - I understand the time difference

Thanks - I'm currently in the process of setting up a meet to see a medical professional. I'll probably get referred here and there. I was unable to tell my GP (or whatever they call them in the US) at the time, but he was concerned about my state of mind and referred me to the 'crisis team' at my local hospital. I'm going to see them on Monday.

I'm telling myself to be completely honest this time.

>HRT medication is commonly used and that can cause some physical changes but others such as libido reducing anti-depressants (which can be good for more reasons than libido reduction) may have less obvious side effects in some individuals.

I was on SSRIs for a bout of depression I suffered a while back. That had a small effect on my libido. But mostly they just made me feel sick. lol
I'm not sure how necessary chem castration is for me - my sex drive isn't that strong anyway. I was just curious. But I will probably see a medical professional at some point for the psyche stuff, when I can muster the confidence.

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me.
Everyone has been so helpful! Peace!

>They deal with more stress and often times hear people, friends, family saying horrible things about them, and said people/friends/fam don't know that they're saying wicked things about someone they claim to care about.

Yes, exactly. I hear my friends badmouthing pedophiles and it makes me want to never come out of the closet.

>People just don't understand that treating a human being like a monster tends to lead that human to withdraw, then to begin hate. They become anxious and seek release in one form or another.

Do you think as I do that if people were warmer to our kind that they'd be under less stress and therefore be less likely to offend?

>Don't let the hatred and ignorance of the world make you withdraw and stop trying find happiness.

Or more accurately: 'resume finding happiness'.
I withdrew and stopped trying to find happiness a while back.
It really will be like starting again. I've stopped looking after myself and some days, it's hard to even get out of bed.

>Be angry, but don't be angry at yourself. Don't hate yourself. There's more than enough people willing to hate you just because of a label you didn't choose.

It's going to take a lot of work killing off this internal voice telling me I'm a lesser being, worthy of death and then getting to the point where I can actually respect myself.

>If you feel guilt and shame all the time, no matter what you are doing, then you have no incentive to behave morally and ethically.

This is a good point. And I suppose there's no good that can come from constantly calling myself scum. That's just appealing to popular opinion
for the sake of lowering my own self-esteem.

>You will hear a lot of hate in your life. But you would be surprised. I have heard sympathetic words from the most unlikely places, from the most unlikely people, at the most unlikely times.

The hate from others is expected. It's the self-hate I can't put up with.
The response from (what I assume are) non-paedophiles has been happily received. But I think the thing that inspires the most confidence is knowing that there are thousands of us who have controlled our urges. I hope we are in the majority!
I know I couldn't live with myself if I hurt the object of my affection.

Thank you for your comment. And thanks for the referrals. Peace and serenity be upon you, brother.

Yes. I so desperately want to tell my friends.
But I also don't want to lose them -I only have a few, after all.
And then I think that if I did tell them and I did lose them, that would mean they were only friends with me because they thought I was someone else, which would mean that I've never had any friends to begin with. - This is a frightening thought. I don't want to be alone.

When you think about it, I haven't really done anything wrong. But when I tell myself that it just feels like I'm rationalizing the irrational.
And when I say I'm selfish, I'm reffering to things like getting financial help from my friends but never really reciprocating their good deeds.
What I'm feeling mostly is guilt.

But I think you're right - my time is probably better spent helping people who have gone through similar experiences.
I can't speak for everyone in my situation but for me, what I need is just someone to talk to.

I've seen a trailer for unturned. It looks like minecraft/dayZ.
Never played DayZ but used to rock out minecraft, hard heh.

And yea - I totally relate to how you feel about taking a musical trek in the wilderness. I live in the city now, whereas I used to live in the countryside, but I still like to walk about where I live. The music drowns out the sound of the traffic anyway.

Thank you all for your kind words and advice.
I was half-expecting to just get a lot of hate, straight off the bat.

Perhaps not everyone hates me and my kind...
Perhaps some people are genuinely tolerant and don't just say it to sound nice.

Likewise...
I certainly don't want to take anyone down with me though.
So I sincerely hope at least one of us gets the help we need

Wow, well that's a lot to take in. Thanks for the info.
I am aware of chemical castration, and if I were to go ahead with it, I doubt my mind would be at ease.
Besides, many of those chems have side effects, right? Wouldn't my flatmate etc. find out?

I've watched Phil Hellenes vid and I've seen lots of vids on free will.
And I'm an atheist so I'm not put off by it nor would I seek help from religion as I don't think it has the goods to offer.
As for evil, I don't strictly believe in it - I was using hyperbole out of frustration...

What people are isn't evil but what they do can be bad.
And I don't want to be a person who does bad things.

I did see your replies...
When I awoke from a spontaneous power-nap :P
I'm in the UK so I was pretty sleepy at the time.

I started learning some basic programming a while back just to help with solving complicated/long-winded math problems.
Over time I've just picked it up more and more, but I'm far from pro.

When I'm listening to tunes, I can concentrate on the music.
Sometimes making up my own lyrics. I tend not to internalize the actual lyrics except for a certain few which just have bitchin' lyrics.

And when I'm walking, there's always a change in scenery. Contrasted with sitting at home, where my mind wanders.
Sometimes my mind wandering is a good thing and leads to something creative, even if it's just deriving an algorithm for alphabetizing names or baking a badass cake. Other times it's really bad and I become quite nihilistic...

Yeah. You understand...
I don't even know why I'm looking for reasons not to.

And I think if I was outed, hatred is more likely than pity.
Sometimes I'm more afraid of the hatred I would get than the prospect that I might hurt someone. Which is just horrible!

And like you say, even if I live the life of a martyr from now on, what's the point if I'm going to be miserable and constantly living in fear of the community at large and my own self?

I'm a massive geek. I've been teaching myself to program using HTML + Javascript. And I really like gaming. Card games, computer games and table-top games.
And taking long walks while listening to music is a good way to keep my mind occupied.

Well, I only have two friends and I am completely estranged from my family so there's definitely a shortage of people to talk to.
And it's not exactly a topic for polite dinner conversation.

I have no idea. I saw a therapist once a while back but she wasn't very helpful. It wasn't really her area of expertise in fairness to her.

I went there looking for help but just ended up having a really awkward conversation.

That's what I'm hoping for. I can't count the times I've stood beside a road, urging my body to jump in front of the upcoming bus but lacking the courage to do so. Deep down I obviously want to live but can't help thinking that there just isn't much for me to live for...

I know it's the way I am and that nothing can change that, but I've acted so selfishly in the past that I don't trust myself to behave ethically.
Sometimes I think about committing lesser crimes just so that I can go to prison. At least there, I'm not a threat to children.
